name: Opyn v1

After option expiry, vault owners can call redeemVaultBalance() on each oToken contract to reclaim their ETH collateral. The Opyn v1 protocol was superseded by Gamma (v2) in late 2020 and the frontend no longer supports v1.

name: Mesa / Gnosis Protocol v1

name: UMA Yield Dollar

name: Unagii ETH Vault

name: GavCoin
description: GavCoin 2015 bonding curve. refund(price, units) requires BOTH balance >= units AND receipt[price].units >= units. Each user may have multiple receipts at different prices from incremental buyins; this scan greedy-refunds price-descending against live balanceOf to compute the max claimable per address. Tokens that moved via transfer() leave receipts orphaned at the sender (receipt > balance, partly unrefundable) and unrefundable on the recipient (balance > 0, no receipt). Reconstructed via Buyin/Refund event replay from block 350000.

name: Gnosis Auction
description: Gnosis EasyAuction unclaimed WETH refunds. The gnosis-auction UI is dead; the contract is immutable with no deadline. Per-user balance is the exact WETH refund from simulating claimFromParticipantOrder via eth_call.

Addresses affected by the May-2022 UST/Terra depeg were compensated in PWRD (Gro's USD stablecoin) on a 2-year merkle vesting schedule that ended 2024-05-31. Everyone can now claim their full remaining allocation. PWRD is redeemable ~1:1 to USDC, which is what the v2 hero counter tracks here.

name: DutchX dx_2
description: DutchX exchange proxy (dx_2). Three claim layers — L1 direct WETH/SAI balances (withdraw only), L2 unclaimed auction positions (claimBuyerFunds/claimSellerFunds + withdraw), L3 partially-claimed positions (same two-step flow). Positions use compressed fields: t=type(buyer/seller), st=sellToken, bt=buyToken, ai=auctionIndex, w=claimable_weth. Unattributable gap: ~6.3 ETH.

name: DutchX dx_3
description: DutchX exchange proxy (dx_3). WETH and SAI only. Three claim layers — L1 direct WETH/SAI balances (withdraw only), L2/L3 unclaimed auction positions (claimBuyerFunds/claimSellerFunds + withdraw). Positions carry received_token/received_symbol — check the field, do not assume WETH. sai_balance = total claimable SAI (direct + positions); sai_direct = direct L1 SAI only. Unattributable gap: ~23 WETH / ~2,439 SAI.

name: SingularX Fund
description: SingularX was a decentralized exchange launched in 2017 on ConsenSys's Tokit platform. Its SingularDTVFund contract distributed ETH trading-fee rewards pro-rata to SNGX token holders, who claim their share by calling withdrawReward(). The exchange and its UI are long defunct, but the reward pool still holds ETH and the claim path remains permissionless.

name: dYdX Solo Margin
description: dYdX's original Solo Margin lending and margin-trading contract. The v1/v2 web app was retired when dYdX moved to StarkEx and then to its own chain, but Solo itself was never wound down: it still holds the WETH, USDC and DAI its suppliers deposited, and every balance remains withdrawable by its owner. Positions are held in numbered sub-accounts rather than against a plain address, so a single wallet may have several separate balances to claim.

name: Uniswap UNI Airdrop
description: The September 2020 UNI genesis distribution. Every address that used Uniswap before that month was allocated UNI through a merkle distributor, but claiming needs a merkle proof and the interface that served those proofs is long gone. The contract never expired and was never swept, so the remaining allocations are still claimable.

name: Set Protocol (TokenSets)
description: Set Protocol powered TokenSets, an automated portfolio product from 2019-2021 where each strategy was an ERC-20 token backed by real collateral held in a shared vault. The TokenSets front end is gone, but the vault still holds the collateral and redemption is still open: burning a Set token returns its underlying share, unwrapped straight back to ETH.
